scientific_integrity: The mathematical statement uses the ideal-coproduct notion as defined in arXiv:2609.23351 and credits the antecedent annihilator criterion; the new assertion is the complete Noetherian classification and discrete topology. Proof and verifier are provided; no external or independent audit is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Applies only to commutative Noetherian unital rings. Finite exhaustive examples corroborate but do not replace the Krull-intersection/Nakayama proof. Some potentially relevant unindexed literature and all late passages of the motivating full text could not be independently compared.
title: Coprime spectra of Noetherian rings detect Artinian Gorenstein components
